q: How does a Surat water-jet weaving unit count electricity per metre of fabric?
title: Surat water-jet looms: power per metre
short: Divide the month's electricity emissions by the metres woven that month: kWh times 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, over metres from the production register. Include the pumps and compressors on the same bill, since they serve the looms.
audience: Water-jet and rapier weaving units in the Surat cluster making synthetic fabric

p: Take kWh from the bill for the weaving shed.
Multiply by 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh.
Divide by metres woven in the same period, from the register.
If heavy and light qualities share one bill, split by loom hours or picks rather than by metres, and note the rule.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
